estimates.name: Accounting Policies and Estimates of the Company
estimates.t: We believe the following critical accounting policies affect our more significant estimates and judgments used in the preparation of our condensed consolidated financial statements.

estimates.name: Revenue Recognition
estimates.t: For performance obligations satisfied at a point in time, there are no significant judgments made in evaluating when the customer obtains control of the promised service.

estimates.name: Digital Assets
estimates.t: We account for our digital assets in accordance with ASU 2023-08, Accounting for and Disclosure of Crypto Assets .

estimates.name: Income Taxes
estimates.t: We account for income taxes under the asset and liability method in accordance with ASC 740, Accounting for Income Taxes .

estimates.name: Accounting Estimates of Consolidated Funds
estimates.t: We believe the following critical accounting policies affect the consolidated funds’ more significant estimates and judgments used in the preparation of our consolidated financial statements.

estimates.name: Consolidated Fund Revenues
estimates.t: In accordance with ASC 606, our consolidated funds apply the five-step framework in determining the timing and amount of revenue to recognize.

estimates.name: Consolidated funds – hospitality revenue
estimates.t: In May 2025, the Company deconsolidated DoubleTree by Hilton Tucson Convention Center (“TCC”), which was the only consolidated fund with hospitality revenues.

estimates.name: Consolidated funds – other revenue
estimates.t: Consolidated funds - other revenue primarily consists of rental revenue of $1.0 million and $2.7 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, and $0.1 million and $0.5 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively.

estimates.name: Consolidated Fund Expenses
estimates.t: Consolidated fund expenses consist primarily of costs, expenses and fees that are incurred by, or arise out of the operation and activities of or otherwise related to, the consolidated funds, including, without limitation, operating costs, depreciation and amortization, interest expense on debt held…

estimates.name: Fair Value of Financial Instruments
estimates.t: The fair value of the consolidated funds’ financial instruments is estimated using available market information and established valuation methodologies.
